alerts.areaDescription: Coastal Odisha (Puri, Jagatsinghpur, Kendrapara, Bhadrak, Baleswar) & West Bengal Coast
alerts.description: Squally wind speed reaching 45-55 kmph gusting to 65 kmph likely along and off Odisha and West Bengal coasts. Fishermen advised not to venture into deep sea.
alerts.instruction: Move small boats to safety. Keep emergency dry rations, battery torches, and powerbanks charged. Avoid low-lying coastal beaches.
alerts.title: Bay of Bengal Deep Depression & Cyclone Watch

alerts.description: Isolated heavy to very heavy rainfall accompanied by thunder and lightning expected over coastal districts.
alerts.instruction: Follow local DDMA alerts. Stay away from electric poles and waterlogged causeways.
alerts.title: Heavy Rainfall & Gale Advisory: North Andhra Coast
